header.save_all_desc: Back up every project as one ZIP
header.load_all_desc: Restore all projects from a workspace ZIP

upload.hint: PNG, JPG, WebP · auto-compressed to <900 KB
upload.fallback_hint: Falls back to EN if empty

quota.title: MyMemory daily limit reached
quota.description: AppShotDeck uses <link>MyMemory</link> for translations. Their free tier allows 500 words/day. Add your email to double it — no account needed.
quota.privacy: Stored locally. Only sent to MyMemory. 1,000 words/day free.

tips.pos: Shifts the device on the canvas. 0 = centered. Use the center button to snap to center, or reset to the default layout position.
tips.size: Scales the device up or down uniformly. 100% fills the default slot size.
tips.tilt: Rotates the 3D frame in perspective. Drag left or right up to ±60°.
tips.apply_bg: Copies this slide's background to every other slide in the project.
tips.apply_text: Copies font, size, color, alignment and shadow to every other slide.

help.title: Help
help.start_1: Upload a screenshot in the Upload tab
help.start_2: Pick a device frame in the Frame tab
help.start_3: Set a background and edit headline text
help.start_4: Click Export Slides to download PNGs
help.tip_apply: Use Apply to all in the Background and Text panels to sync a style across every slide at once.
help.tip_save_all: Save All Projects backs up your entire workspace — handy before switching devices.
help.tip_tilt: 3D frames have a Tilt slider in the Frame tab. Drag it to add perspective depth.
help.tip_slides: Each project supports up to 8 slides, each with its own format, frame, and background.
help.translate_1: Open the Text tab and expand Translations
help.translate_2: Click + to add a language — auto-translate or fill manually
help.translate_3: Switch languages above the canvas to preview each one
help.translate_4: Use Protected words to keep brand names untranslated
help.translate_5: Export per language from the Export Slides dropdown
help.callout_1: Go to the Callout tab in the sidebar
help.callout_2: Drag a rectangle on the screenshot to define the area to zoom
help.callout_3: A zoom bubble appears — drag it anywhere on the canvas to reposition
help.callout_4: Click a bubble to select it, then press Delete to remove it
help.screenshots_1: After adding translations, use the Replace button below the canvas to upload language-specific screenshots
help.screenshots_2: The language label below the buttons shows which variant you're replacing (e.g., ES · Español · Spanish)
help.screenshots_3: Use 'Use default' to remove a custom screenshot and fall back to the EN default

callout.hint: Drag on the screenshot to create a zoom callout
callout.hint_max: Max 3 callouts — remove one to add another

translations.error_limit: Daily limit reached — try tomorrow or fill manually
translations.error_length: Text too long for auto-translation (max 450 chars)
translations.scope_hint: Applies to all {{count}} slide(s) in this project.
translations.protected_hint: Won't be translated. Press Enter or comma to add.
translations.sync_all_done: All translations are up to date
